description:
Odds from Polymarket and Kalshi: search a topic on both venues, or look up one market, with optional price history and order book. Prices are market-implied probabilities, not ground truth; matching the same question across venues is best effort. Example: {"query":"fed december"} or {"market":"KXFED-26DEC","include":["odds","history"]}.

Costs 2 credits; each optional include entry (history, orderbook) adds 1. Every section carries its own source receipt (provider, fetched_at, runtime_status); a section that fails is listed under missing and never guessed.

include.description: Default: odds. Optional: history (price history of the top market per venue), orderbook.

market.description: One market: a Polymarket slug or a Kalshi ticker.

query.description: A topic to search, for example "fed december" or "bitcoin 150k".

response_format.description: Output format: 'json' for structured data (default) or 'markdown' for human-readable text.

venue.description: Default both for a search; a market is looked up on the venue its id fits.

name: prediction_markets
title: Prediction Markets
